seal.statement: Follow-ups the test-placement and lab-worker-provisioning verifiers recorded, finished at the owner's request (2026-09-18). (1) A push from a linked worktree runs the pre-push test stage with git's GIT_DIR exported, and twelve test files still spawn committing, configuring or resetting git with the inherited environment - the 2026-09-13 incident that wrote fixture identity and core.bare into the real repository. Instead of twelve per-file repairs, the test runner now removes inherited git repository pointers from every test process it starts, so no fixture can reach the pusher's repository and a test in the gate reads the checkout it runs in. (2) Closing the terminal (SIGHUP) during a placed run left the detached controller child and the lab wrappers running: SIGHUP now stops them like SIGINT and SIGTERM. (3) An interrupted lab shard killed its wrapper group at once, so in local mode the lab shell died before its trap cleaned up; abort now lets the shell finish, bounded, before cutting it. (4) The controller child's LAGRANGE_PLACEMENT=local, unwitnessed so far, gets a witness.

text: scripts/run-test-files.js builds every test process's environment through gitProcessEnvironment(), so GIT_DIR, GIT_WORK_TREE, GIT_INDEX_FILE and the other inherited repository pointers never reach a test file - one owner instead of twelve per-file repairs of fixtures that commit, configure or reset git. scripts/lab/probe.js: SIGHUP joins SIGINT and SIGTERM in stopping a placed run; an aborted shard's lab shell is given up to 5 s (a shell poll on the wrapper pid, zombies counted as ended, since a signal handler has no event loop to wait in) to run its trap before the wrapper group is cut. Witnesses: a fixture run by the runner with the three pointers set sees none; an emitted SIGHUP aborts the lab run and the controller child and exits 130; a real local-mode shard aborted mid-run leaves no worktree, ref, bundle, file list or runner group; the controller child leads its own group and its /proc environ carries LAGRANGE_PLACEMENT=local. Each goes red under its mutation (unscrubbed env, no SIGHUP, no grace, no placement=local). Also from the provisioning verifier: the checkout test installs its GIT_DIR decoy before its first git, and a workflow-level variable is witnessed as refused.

round 1 REJECT (1 blocking). B1: runPlacedTestFiles registered its handler with signals.once; Node removes a once listener before running it, which hands the signal back to its default action, so a second SIGHUP (a real hangup sends two: bash resends to its jobs, then the kernel to the old foreground group) or a second Ctrl-C during the abort's ssh kill or 5 s grace killed the controller mid-abort and orphaned the detached wrappers. Measured: two kill -HUP 300 ms apart against the real runPlacedTestFiles exit 129 with only one lab aborted; a real pty hangup completed the abort 1 of 6 times, 6 of 6 with on. The witness emitted one SIGHUP on a fake emitter and could not see it. Verified sound: the runner scrub (both spawn sites through prepareTestRun; nothing passes a git pointer in options.env; with the scrub removed check-quest-log-append-only wrote a commit and user.name into a decoy GIT_DIR - the 2026-09-13 incident - with it the decoy stays untouched), the premise (git exports an absolute GIT_DIR to pre-push from a linked worktree only), the abort grace (bounded ~5.9 s, spawnSync cap 10 s, missing ps = immediate cut, no pid reuse), nohup/setsid no regression, 5/5 mutations killed, all static checks, ratchets 1819/1819 and 160/160, audits, harness 4/4, probe done. Observations: O1 sequential grace, (10 s ssh + 5 s grace) per shard with the controller child aborted last - signal all, wait once, cut, controller child first; O2 the gate's re-run hook in push-gate-corpus-worktree gateExactSha inherits the pusher's GIT_DIR, so its rev-parse HEAD, status and lint range read the pusher's linked worktree; O3 SIGHUP exits 130 not 129 (predates); O4 fixture checks 3 of 8 pointers (gitProcessEnvironment owns the list); O5 run-test-files.js triggers the whole corpus at land.

round 1 repair. B1: the handler is registered with signals.on and guarded against re-entry (aborting flag), and the finally block still removes it; a second SIGHUP or Ctrl-C during the abort now reaches a live listener that returns at once. New witness 'a second hang-up during the abort neither kills it nor repeats it': from inside a lab shard's interrupt it asserts listenerCount('SIGHUP') > 0 and emits SIGHUP again, then requires every side aborted exactly once and a single exit 130. O1: abort is now two-phase - runRemote returns interrupt() (asks the lab shell to stop, returns the wrapper pid to wait for and its cut), and abortTogether asks every lab shell first, waits once over all wrapper pids (PLACEMENT_WAIT_SCRIPT now takes a poll count and any number of pids), then cuts; the controller child is cut first. A run's own abort() is abortTogether of itself. The same witness requires the order controller, ask lab1, ask lab2, cut lab1, cut lab2. Mutations killed: once, guard removed, controller last, per-shard ask-then-cut. O2: gateExactSha builds the re-run hook's env from gitProcessEnvironment(); witness 'the gate reads its own checkout under a push hook's GIT_DIR' in proof-authority-falsifiers gates baseSha with GIT_DIR set to a linked worktree whose HEAD moved on, and requires no pointer in the command and rev-parse HEAD = the gated sha (red with ...process.env restored). Statement updated for all three. O3/O4/O5 unchanged (O3 predates; O4 by design; O5 the land runs the corpus). Pre-commit, ratchets 1819/1819 and 160/160, audit:shards, unused:push, run-test-files, lab-worker-provisioning, pre-push-hook-control-flow, push-gate-change-proof, test-placement, proof-authority-falsifiers green; harness 4/4.

round 2 APPROVE, judged against the sealed statement and constraints (statement byte-identical to the seal after the restore, doneWhen identical). B1 repaired, measured against the real runPlacedTestFiles with two fake lab shells whose TERM trap takes 1 s: a double kill -HUP 300 ms apart exits 130 in the order controller, ask lab1, ask lab2, one shared ~1.06 s grace, cut lab1, cut lab2 (round 1: exit 129, lab2 and controller orphaned); double kill -INT the same; a real pty hangup completes the abort 6 of 6 (round 1: 1 of 6); nothing left running. O1 repaired: abortTogether asks every lab shell, waits once, cuts - two 1 s traps cost ~1.1 s, not 2 s; the multi-pid wait is bounded (two never-exiting pids ~6.1 s, five ~6.9 s, spawnSync cap 10 s), zombies ending at 0.3/0.6 s return in 671 ms, a gone pid counts as ended. O2 repaired: the falsifier passes and goes red with ...process.env restored, printing the linked worktree's gitdir; no inner-hook stage needs the pusher's pointer. Mutations killed: once, guard removed, controller last, per-shard ask-then-cut, grace wait removed, SIGHUP removed, LAGRANGE_PLACEMENT=local removed, O2 unscrubbed env. Checks green: test-placement 11, proof-authority-falsifiers 6, run-test-files 34, lab-worker-provisioning 6, pre-push-hook-control-flow 12, push-gate-change-proof 14; eslint, guideline-literals, decision-boundaries, ambient-intrinsics, silent-catch; complexity 1819/1819, cognitive 160/160, audit:shards, unused:push, file-size, staged-constant-names; inventory fresh; harness 4/4; probe done. Constraints hold: the runner stays the one owner for test processes (the gate scrub is the hook's environment, not a per-file repair); bounded-abort holds. Non-blocking: N1 a shard still uploading (no placement-shell line yet) returns pid null and is now cut after the shared grace (up to ~6 s) rather than at once - remotely its shell dies on the next write to the closed channel; N2 the ask phase does the ssh kills one after another (predates); N3 the O2 file lies outside the four named items, recorded in the repair attempt; O3-O5 unchanged.
